verses.text: A song. A psalm of David. My heart is steady, God. I will sing and make music with all my soul.
Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
LORD, I will thank you among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
Your faithful love is higher than the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
God, be honoured above the skies! Let your glory be over all the earth.
Save us with your right hand and answer us, so the people you love may be rescued.
God has spoken from his holy place: "I will win! I will divide up Shechem and measure out the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim is my helmet. Judah is my sceptre.
Moab is my washbowl. I will throw my sandal on Edom to show I own it. I will shout in victory over Philistia."
Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
God, haven't you rejected us? You no longer go out with our armies, God.
Help us against the enemy, because human help is useless.
With God we will fight bravely, and he will trample down our enemies.
